svg.title: Sphere — layer asset for Icon Composer
svg.desc: Free-standing sphere on a transparent background, 1024×1024, centre 512/512, radius 340. The gradient is radial and offset towards the upper left so the surface reads as volumetric. Deliberately WITHOUT specular highlight, shadow or opacity — reflection and transparency come from Icon Composer. Recolouring: change only the stop-color values below.
